content: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping – in theaters & IMAX November 20. Subscribe to the LIONSGATE YouTube Channel for the latest movie trailers, clips, and more: https://bit.ly/2Z6nfym https://www.instagram.com/thehungergames https://www.facebook.com/TheHungerGamesMovie https://www.threads.com/@thehungergames https://x.com/TheHungerGames https://www.tiktok.com/@hungergamesofficial #TheHungerGames From acclaimed director Francis Lawrence, THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING follows sixteen-year-old Haymitch Abernathy (Joseph Zada) from District 12, beginning on the morning of the reaping for the 50th Annual Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell, the biggest Games yet with twice as many tributes. Set in the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, the story follows Haymitch into the arena, where he forms an unlikely alliance with fellow tribute Maysilee Donner (Mckenna Grace) and joins a coalition determined to challenge the Capitol’s control under President Snow (Ralph Fiennes). As the competition unfolds, Haymitch risks everything to take down the Games from within the arena — setting in motion the rebellion that will change Panem forever. Based on Suzanne Collins’ best-selling novel, THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING also stars Jesse Plemons, Glenn Close, Kieran Culkin, Elle Fanning, Maya Hawke, Whitney Peak, and Kelvin Harrison Jr. Produced by Nina Jacobson, Brad Simpson and Francis Lawrence. Screenplay by Billy Ray and Michael Lesslie.

chineseContent: 《饥饿游戏：收割日出》 – 11 月 20 日在影院和 IMAX 上映。订阅 LIONSGATE YouTube 频道以获取最新电影预告片、剪辑等：https://bit.ly/2Z6nfym https://www.instagram.com/thehungergames https://www.facebook.com/TheHungerGamesMovie https://www.threads.com/@thehungergames https://x.com/TheHungerGames https://www.tiktok.com/@hungergamesofficial #TheHungerGames 由著名导演弗朗西斯·劳伦斯执导的《饥饿游戏：收割日出》讲述了来自第 12 区的 16 岁黑密斯·阿伯内西（约瑟夫·扎达饰）的故事，从第 50 届年度饥饿游戏（也称为第二届）收割的早晨开始。 Quarter Quell，迄今为止规模最大的奥运会，致敬人数是之前的两倍。故事发生在《饥饿游戏》事件发生 24 年前的施惠国世界，故事讲述黑密斯进入竞技场，与贡品梅西莉·唐纳（麦肯娜·格蕾斯饰）结成不可思议的联盟，并加入了一个决心挑战斯诺总统（拉尔夫·费因斯饰）对国会大厦控制的联盟。随着比赛的展开，黑密斯冒着一切风险从竞技场内推翻奥运会——引发了将永远改变施惠国的叛乱。 《饥饿游戏：收割日出》改编自苏珊娜·柯林斯的畅销小说，主演包括杰西·普莱蒙、格伦·克洛斯、基兰·卡尔金、艾丽·范宁、玛雅·霍克、惠特尼·皮克和小凯尔文·哈里森。由尼娜·雅各布森、布拉德·辛普森和弗朗西斯·劳伦斯制作。比利·雷和迈克尔·莱斯利编剧。
